verdict.rationale: Vestd is UK-based and provides strong support for UK EMI schemes, including scheme setup, granting options, and HMRC-relevant valuation/tax considerations during exercise (vestd-docs-6, vestd-docs-14, vestd-docs-15, vestd-docs-5). However, there is no evidence of support for non-UK, non-US country-specific option plans or valuations for other international entities beyond the UK/US split. missing for 10: evidence of option plans/valuations for jurisdictions outside UK and US, multi-country entity support, localized tax compliance for other countries.
